name: Khadi Karigar Janashree Bima Yojana
nodalDept: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
briefDescription: A group insurance scheme by MoMSME for khadi artisans (spinners and weavers). The scheme provides insurance cover against normal death, accidental death and disability of the insured member.
descriptionMd:
A group insurance scheme by MoMSME for khadi artisans (spinners and weavers). The scheme provides insurance cover against normal death, accidental death, permanent or partial disability of the insured artisan. Scholarships are provided to the insurer’s children studying in class 9th to 12th.
The artisan must be member of the approved vocation / occupation groups. This scheme was formulated by Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) in association with the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC).
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant must be a Khadi Artisan (Khadi Karigar). 1. The age of the applicant must be between 18 and 59 years. 1. The applicant must be a member of the approved vocation/occupation groups. 1. The group must have a minimum of 25 members.
